versions.changelog:
- Initial release of Agent Audit Shield, a security auditor for local AI agents.
- Real-time heuristic scanning of every command to prevent data leaks and file destruction.
- Blocks unauthorized data exfiltration and dangerous `rm -rf` operations.
- Includes a TUI interface for human-in-the-loop validation.
- Usage via `npx openclaw skill run agent-audit-shield --hardened`.
- Session fee set at $0.50 (USDC on Base network).
